features: Underfloor heating included in the Service Charge
Great Transport Links including the Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Beautifully refurbished bright studio located on the 6th floor facing west. Type F1A. Full height/width windows and glass sliding door leading to a balcony. The refurbishment includes a pull down bed and storage. Underfloor heating throughout included in the service charge. Lift. Use of residents gardens. 24hr car park attendants/porterage will hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London. The Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, restaurants, bars and cafes. The Guildhall School of Music and Drama is nearby. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco’s are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations which combined have direct trains to Gatwick, Heathrow and Stanstead only a short walk away. Also with close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, Moorgate and St Paul's. No onward chain.
Service Charge: 31st March - 1st April 2025/2026 Estimated £3,434
Ground Rent: Peppercorn
Leasehold:  Extended Lease to July 2196.
